description: What the hive compiler refuses, and the message it gives

examples.intent: A field the event does not have

input.natural_language: Offer to restart the crashed service, naming it
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="service-crash">
    <qh:offer title="Restart {svc}" action="restart-service" service="{service}" />
  </qh:on>
  <qh:allow service="nginx" />
</q:application>

expected_error.message: not a field of service-crash (it has: unit, service, exit_code)

examples.why_invalid: {svc} could never be filled in: service-crash has unit, service and exit_code.

examples.intent: An offer the whitelist would refuse

input.natural_language: Offer the recent logs of a crashed service
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="service-crash">
    <qh:offer title="Show recent logs" action="run-command" cmd="journalctl" args="-n 50 -u {service}" />
  </qh:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: No <qh:allow command=> lets the actuator run journalctl: the admin would approve an offer that fails.
examples.correction: Add <qh:allow command="journalctl" args="-n 50 -u *" /> (a `*` where the {service} goes).

input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="service-crash">
    <qh:offer title="Restart sshd" action="restart-service" service="sshd" />
  </qh:on>
  <qh:allow service="sshd" />
  <qh:block service="ssh*" />
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: A block always wins over an allow; the actuator would refuse the restart.
examples.correction: Leave sshd to its administrator, or remove the block.

examples.intent: A text field where a number goes

input.natural_language: End the process holding the port
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="port-conflict">
    <qh:offer title="End it" action="kill-port-process" port="{holder}" />
  </qh:on>
  <qh:allow action="kill-port-process" />
</q:application>

expected_error.message: port= is a number; {holder} of port-conflict is text

examples.why_invalid: port= takes a number, and {holder} is a program's name.

examples.intent: A permission the file does not give

input.natural_language: End the process holding the port
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="port-conflict">
    <qh:offer title="End it" action="kill-port-process" port="{port}" />
  </qh:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: kill-port-process is a permission with no list behind it, off unless the file switches it on.

examples.intent: An event the Hive does not report

input.natural_language: Offer something at the full moon

examples.why_invalid: The events are the observations the nerves report; a rule on anything else would never fire.
examples.correction: Use one of the events listed in the message.

examples.intent: An action the actuator does not have

input.natural_language: Offer a reboot when the disk is full

expected_error.message: is not an action the actuator has

examples.why_invalid: Rebooting, shutting down and suspending are never offered: the actuator has no switch for them.
examples.correction: Offer something the actuator may do, such as run-command df -h.

input.natural_language: Offer a restart without saying of what

expected_error.message: not part of the hive language

examples.why_invalid: A hive is declarations: events, offers and permissions. There is nothing to compute in it.
examples.correction: Remove the q:set; what the Hive remembers is the daemons' own.

input.natural_language: Clean up when the disk is full
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="disk-low">
    if full then apt clean
  </qh:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: Text inside a tag is script, and the language has no escape hatch.
examples.correction: Write the offer as a tag: <qh:offer title="Clean the package cache" action="clean-package-cache" />.

input.natural_language: Offer the disk usage, and elsewhere a cache clean, on a full disk
input.quantum_code:
<q:application id="bad" type="hive">
  <qh:on event="disk-low">
    <qh:offer title="Clean the package cache" action="clean-package-cache" />
  </qh:on>
  <qh:on event="disk-low">
    <qh:offer title="Refresh the lists" action="update-package-lists" />
  </qh:on>
</q:application>

examples.why_invalid: One rule per event keeps the order of its offers in one place.
examples.correction: Put both offers in one <qh:on event="disk-low">.

examples.intent: An allow of two things at once

input.natural_language: Allow nginx and the home directories

examples.why_invalid: Each <qh:allow> permits one kind of thing, so a reader sees at a glance what each line allows.
